text:
alicia: FYI — exec escalation from Evergreen Health. CFO + CISO want answers before committing to a Dedicated POC. They want VPC peering + BYO-KMS and a short pricing protection window. Need quick sync with eng/legal.

sandeep: Ack. Do we have an approved BYO-KMS playbook for Dedicated/private? I can scope infra impact but need legal/KMS requirements.

clare: I can own the customer-facing timeline and run the POC checklist. Can someone confirm which regions+instance types we can guarantee for a 2-week dedicated trial?

matt: We can do eu-west-1 and us-west-2 on our Dedicated pool. For BYO-KMS we need a cert from ops on key wrapping support — estimated 3 business days to validate.

emily-legal: @alicia please send the exact CISO questions. High level: we can provide a KMS integration brief and an attestation letter, but anything requiring contractual changes needs SOC/comms review and SLA signoff.

alicia: Pasting the CISO asks from their email (redacted):
- Are you able to support customer-managed keys (BYO-KMS) for model encryption at rest?
- Can you ensure network isolation (VPC peering + strict egress rules) during POC?
- Data retention policy for logs and traces, and export for audit.
- Can you provide a point-in-time performance SLA for the Dedicated pool during POC?

jordan-cs: Customer also asked for a 10% price credit if we fail SLOs during the trial. They asked to lock pricing for 30 days post-POC while they finalize procurement.

matt: Quick technical note: BYO-KMS is supported for model artifacts at rest via envelope encryption. For request path and runtime cache we currently manage keys; full BYO for runtime needs additional engineering (KV cache encryption). I can list tradeoffs.

clare: For the timeline: if we start validation Monday, eng cert by Thu, legal attestation by Fri, POC can start next Tue. Is that acceptable to them?

alicia: They asked for an earlier start — CFO wants exec bridge tomorrow EOD to unblock procurement. Can we do a short exec sync (15m) to provide status and confirm commitments?

escalation-bot: Automated reminder: please update the escalation tracker with current status.

emily-legal: I can join an exec bridge but need the specific attestation language. I can draft a non-binding attestation for BYO-KMS support and a data handling summary for the CISO. Not ready to change contract terms on the call.

sandeep: Action items for engineering: 1) confirm BYO-KMS envelope flow and list gaps (matt), 2) run a short test of VPC peering with sample workload (me + infra) — ETA 48 hours, 3) produce perf baseline for their expected token/sec (matt).

matt: I'll put a concise tech note into the thread with ETA. Quick config snippet for peering I'll paste to show feasibility:```yaml
peering: true
routes:
  - cidr: 10.12.0.0/16
  - allow: outbound-only
kms_integration:
  - mode: envelope
  - runtime_keys: managed
```

jordan-cs: That snippet should be fine for the CISO; they mostly need to see the architecture and the timeline. Also customer is sensitive about logs — they want logs to be retained 90 days and exportable.

clare: I'll draft a one-pager for the bridge: scope, commitments, timeline, outstanding risks (runtime BYO gap, pricing credit ask, contract changes). Will share in ~2 hours.

alicia: Meeting ask: Exec bridge tomorrow 4:30pm PT — attendees: alicia, matt, emily-legal, sandeep, customer execs. If anyone can't make it, please propose alternate. We need a firm yes/no on the 30-day price lock and 10% credit conversation.

matt: I can make 4:30. I'll have the tech note and perf numbers.

emily-legal: I can make 4:30 — will bring the attestation draft.

sandeep: 4:30 works for me. I'll have peering test started.

clare: OK booked on my calendar, will share the one-pager when ready.

alicia: Thanks team. After the bridge we'll update the tracker and send the CISO packet.

jordan-cs: Customer reply: "Thanks — 4:30 works, appreciate the rapid turn." :thumbsup: 

alicia: Leaving this thread open for pre-bridge questions. If someone posts a short bulleted risk matrix I can include it in the one-pager.

matt: Risks (short): 1) Runtime BYO-KMS not fully supported (mitigation: envelope + clear timeline), 2) Performance variance under small Dedicated pool (mitigation: baseline perf + optional burst capacity), 3) Contract changes (mitigation: attestation only, escalate to legal if asked).

clare: Added those to the one-pager. Sharing in 30m.

emily-legal: Draft attestation shared in drive — link: https://redwood.app/drive/evergreen-attestation (internal)

alicia: Great — I'll queue the invite. Everyone please update the escalation tracker after the call.

escalation-bot: Escalation status updated: state=awaiting-exec-bridge, owner=alicia, updated_at=2680013000

alicia: End thread for now — will post notes after the bridge.
